conviction_note: The headline H1 numbers are already on the wire as unaudited management figures (Jul 21, revised Aug 13). The only thing Monday adds is the auditor-reviewed IFRS set: the full net result including central, legal and treasury lines, plus the balance-sheet detail behind the $106.6M. On this name's own confirmed releases the two formal prints fell about 5% in their first session (Sep 2025 H1 reviewed -5.6%, Mar 2026 FY audited -5.0%), while every unaudited promotional release rose 5-12%. That is a real lean but it rests on two observations, and this time the IFRS line could be a profit because of AI-treasury marks. The findings sum to -1.3 and I emit -1.0, cutting a further 0.3 because the stock is at its 52-week low, 85% off its high and down 20.5% over 20 days, so disbelief is already largely in the price. This is inside the 2.58% deadband and an honest near-zero.

findings.finding: This name's confirmed results releases split cleanly by format. The two auditor-reviewed or audited prints fell in their first session: H1 2025 reviewed on 2025-09-23 went 0.960 to 0.906 (-5.6%), and FY2025 audited on 2026-03-09 went 0.458 to 0.435 (-5.0%), then fell another 10.3% the next day. The unaudited 'net profit from operations' releases rose: Q1 on 2026-04-01 +8.6%, Q2 on 2026-07-01 +12.3%, H1 on 2026-07-21 +4.9%, balance sheet on 2026-08-13 +4.8%. Monday's print is the formal kind. It must show the full IFRS result, including the central, legal and management costs the unaudited releases excluded, and it lands after the Sep 2 release confirmed the $7.97M ICC award is still uncollected (the company still has to petition to confirm it).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Rebuilt from confirmed releases, because the baseline history is 6-K operational updates. Formal reviewed or audited prints: -5.6% and -5.0% (n=2). Unaudited management-number releases: +4.8% to +12.3% (n=4), each fading over the following sessions.
findings.source_date: 2025-09-23 (price rows); FY2025 rows at https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/GNS/history/?period1=1772323200&period2=1775692800 (2026-03-09); ICC status at https://ir.geniusgroup.net/news-events/press-releases/detail/256 (2026-09-02)
findings.why_not_priced: The sealed baseline's history is built from operational 6-Ks, and the wire sees this event only as a date plus numbers it already has, so nobody carries the formal-versus-unaudited split in this name's reactions. If the market had priced a clean confirmation, the stock would not have drifted 20% lower into a print whose headline is already public. If it had priced a formal-print sell-off, the 5-day tape would not be +3.2% into the event. The magnitude is kept small for three reasons: n=2; the IFRS line this time may be a profit thanks to AI-treasury marks (SpaceX +49%, Anthropic re-priced, per the Aug 27 release), where both earlier formal prints were net losses; and whether the ICC award was booked in the unaudited $106.6M is an inference, not a document.
findings.independence: Partial. The Aug 13 release itself flags the H1 figures as 'unaudited ... currently undergoing review' (https://www.stocktitan.net/news/GNS/genius-group-restructures-balance-sheet-increases-book-value-57-year-0s041t1otkff.html). The unaudited numbers already moved once, from 147%/$6.6M on Jul 21 to 156%/$7.0M on Aug 13 (https://www.stocktitan.net/news/GNS/genius-group-launches-full-ai-powered-product-suite-building-on-147-0v2wsq0i4l9u.html). The counterweight, that the IFRS result may be positive on treasury marks, is folded into the size above rather than filed separately.

findings.finding: H1 operational revenue of about $6.5M (Q1 $3.3M, Q2 $3.2M, Q2 down sequentially) is only 30-32% of the $20-22M FY2026 revenue guide given on 2026-03-09. H2 would need $13.5-15.5M, more than double H1. The Sep 17 announcement lists business, treasury and legal updates for Monday but not a guidance reaffirmation.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior guidance revision by this company was found to measure against. The FY2025 audited print, which set this guide, fell 5.0% and then another 10.3%.
findings.why_not_priced: The paid research note (Sep 11/15) and the company releases quote growth rates and never set H1 against the full-year guide, so the gap appears in no summary. It is sized small because a stock at 0.26x claimed book and a 52-week low shows the market already disbelieves the company's forward numbers. If the gap were fully unpriced, the stock would still trade near the Diamond $1.54 target rather than at $0.156.
findings.independence: Uses a different document from the first finding. Q1 and Q2 revenue come from https://ir.geniusgroup.net/news-events/press-releases/detail/248/genius-group-reports-second-quarter-2026-results-112 and https://ir.geniusgroup.net/news-events/press-releases/detail/231/genius-group-reports-first-quarter-2026-results-171.

outside_window.finding: The ICC award of $7.97M cash plus 7.39M shares against LZG International is not collected. The company still has to petition the district court to confirm it, so any recovery is dated well after the exit.
ASX dual listing is guided to Q4 2026 and the Perpetual Preferred $12.5M initial raise is 'subject to confirmation'. Both catalysts sit after the window unless they are announced with the results.

Q3 operational update or preliminary Q3 numbers: nothing found.
baseline_tension: The small negative sits with the free control's usual direction but against the tape: the stock is already -20.5% over 20 days, at its 52-week low and 85% off its high, so disbelief looks largely priced. There is no skew to consult and short interest is modest. The price already has most of this, and the residual is a formal-print tilt on n=2.
lessons_applied: Lesson 5 (documents beat inference): the sub-claim that the auditor review would strip an uncollected ICC receivable from the $106.6M rests on no document showing it was booked. It was demoted to context, taking finding 1 from -1.5 to -1.0.

Lesson 3 (caveat must reach the number): finding 1's own counterweight, that the IFRS H1 may be a profit on AI-treasury marks where both prior formal prints were losses, is now reflected in the size and widens the band to -7/+6.

Lessons 1 and 7 plus the pessimism note: the guidance-gap finding went from -0.5 to -0.3, because the 0.26x-book price and 52-week low show the market already disbelieves the guide, and both findings leaning negative is the known artefact.
Final lesson (untrustworthy history): already applied pre-lessons. The base rate was rebuilt from six confirmed releases, and the -5.16 median from 6-K updates was not used.
